name: A-75 Missile Repeater
description: The Necromancer is a highly experimental government project. It is Equiped with three A-75 Missile Repeaters. The weapon is mounted on top of your ships power cells.  Using the E=MC2 principle it converts your ships power to Consolidated Arms Mk. 83 guided missile.

sprite.rotation: frame 00 nose-up, 10 degrees clockwise per frame
